problem_revision.reason: HarnessFix already performs harness-layer diagnosis plus scoped repair, and Diagnosis Is Not Prescription directly shows that causal responsibility need not identify the best patch locus. A direct cross-surface router would therefore be combination novelty.

rows.paper_problem: Given a failed agent trace and pre-intervention evidence, is the minimal causally sufficient persistent repair surface identifiable at all; if not, what reversible cross-surface evidence is required before a system may commit rather than abstain?
rows.irreducible_boundary: The paper is about partial identification of the repair locus, not fault attribution, scoped patch generation, or direct surface prediction. Multiple persistent surfaces may remain observationally compatible with the same failure and responsibility diagnosis while implying different repair/collateral outcomes. The method must certify IDENTIFIED(surface) only when the compatible model/effect set agrees on one minimal sufficient surface, otherwise return UNIDENTIFIABLE or PROBE_MORE.
rows.current_method_problem: A one-shot learned router or hidden-time best-surface trial is too close to HarnessFix/WML plus generic classification/CATE. The revised method must expose non-identifiability and abstain instead of always predicting a surface.
method_design_requirements: Formalize a finite registered set of persistent repair surfaces with explicit persistence, reversibility, scope, and collateral-effect assumptions.
Define a compatibility set of causal repair models/effect intervals consistent with pre-intervention trace evidence and any already-observed reversible probes.
Define minimal causal sufficiency under frozen task-success, persistence, collateral, and scope constraints; allow multiple incomparable minimal surfaces.
Provide a repair-surface non-identifiability construction: identical pre-intervention evidence/responsibility can be compatible with different minimal sufficient repair loci.
Emit IDENTIFIED(surface) only when every compatible model/effect interval agrees on the same minimal sufficient surface; otherwise abstain.
PROBE_MORE may propose only reversible diagnostic interventions that reduce the compatible surface set; exhaustive persistent repair trials at hidden time remain forbidden.
Separate the certificate from any active probe policy so generic active diagnosis is a same-information baseline rather than hidden novelty.

rows.paper_problem: Can a persistent agent update preserve current utility and old-task retention yet reduce the response of the same frozen future evolution operator to new tasks?
rows.irreducible_boundary: Generic future plasticity is already a continual-learning problem. The surviving agent-specific quantity is evolvability debt: hold the future evolution operator fixed and study update-induced loss of its responsiveness across non-parametric persistent surfaces such as prompt, memory, skill, workflow, and code, not only weight plasticity.
rows.current_method_problem: A sealed future-adaptation AUC gate is a direct look-ahead evaluation and is reducible to CPE-style preservation plus a standard plasticity measurement unless the causal quantity is redefined around a fixed agent evolution operator.
required_problem_revision: Rename the causal quantity from generic future learnability/plasticity to update-induced evolvability debt.
Freeze the future evolution operator, its data/call/update budget, and adaptation rule before the candidate update is evaluated.
Require the phenomenon on at least one non-weight persistent surface; otherwise the contribution collapses toward continual-RL plasticity.
Separate current capability, old-task retention, and future evolution-operator response as three different potential outcomes.
After revision, rerun collision review against continual learning, meta-learning, and self-evolving-agent capability-preservation work before method design.

current-gain + retention + direct future adaptation AUC threshold

rows.paper_problem: A persistent update may reduce aggregate failure while moving residual failures toward more silent, severe, or unrecoverable classes.
rows.irreducible_boundary: Paired longitudinal class transport is descriptively useful, but the current transport matrix plus risk-weighted accept/reject rule is reducible to class-conditional failure accounting unless the transport structure has decision value beyond before/after class marginals.
rows.current_method_problem: If decisions depend only on a risk-weighted delta, the full transport matrix is unnecessary; a same-information per-class risk baseline reproduces the update gate.
